segments.sn37.34:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamānā ariyasāvikā ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati sārādāyinī ca hoti varādāyinī ca kāyassa.
segments.sn37.34:1.3: Saddhāya vaḍḍhati, sīlena vaḍḍhati, sutena vaḍḍhati, cāgena vaḍḍhati, paññāya vaḍḍhati – imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamānā ariyasāvikā ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati, sārādāyinī ca hoti, varādāyinī ca kāyassā”ti.
segments.sn37.34:3.1: Visāradā pasayha abhibhuyya, ekaṃ aṅgena pañcamaṃ;
segments.sn37.34:3.3: Nāsenti hetu ṭhānañca, visārado vaḍḍhinā dasāti.
